entries.sourceCitation: Definition: the line through both ear landmarks is level with true horizontal (Kendall FP et al., Muscles: Testing and Function with Posture and Pain, 5th ed., 2005, ideal alignment).
Definition: the line through both shoulder landmarks is level with true horizontal (Kendall et al. 2005, ideal alignment).
Definition: the line through both hip landmarks is level with true horizontal (Kendall et al. 2005, ideal alignment).
Definition: the hip-midpoint to shoulder-midpoint line is vertical (Kendall et al. 2005, ideal alignment).
Definition: the shoulder midpoint lies vertically above the ankle midpoint (Kendall et al. 2005, ideal alignment).
Definition: the hip-to-shoulder line is vertical in the side view (Kendall et al. 2005, ideal alignment).
Definition: hip, knee and ankle landmarks are collinear in the side view (0 = straight; positive = extended beyond straight).
